span.label: The standard encoding asserts that every pair of sequences is equally unlike every other, which is false of the sequences themselves.
span.note: what this limits: any similarity computed over one-hot k-mer encodings: the distance between any arbitrary pair is equidistant, even though ATGGC should be closer to ATGGG than CACGA
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Every similarity result in the paper is measured against one stipulated alignment scoring, including a gap penalty of zero.
span.note: what this limits: the reported correlation between dna2vec cosine similarity and sequence similarity: the Needleman-Wunsch scores use a match score of 1, mismatch of 0 and gap penalty of 0, so the correlation is with that scoring and not with alignment in general
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The method's justification is a hypothesis about words, carried over to nucleotides, and the paper marks the inspiration as loose.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that dna2vec vectors carry biological meaning: the training objective is warranted by the distributional hypothesis about words appearing in the same context, which the paper says it is loosely inspired by
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
